continuity.verdict: CONTINUITY WORKS: one AgentSession accumulates context across prompt() calls.

busy.note: Maps the right Pi mechanism for user.message-while-running vs user.interrupt.

scenarios.label: prompt() no streamingBehavior (expect throw per docstring)
scenarios.message: Agent is already processing. Specify streamingBehavior ('steer' or 'followUp') to queue the message.

abort.verdict: SURVIVES: same AgentSession is reusable after abort() — no forced eviction needed.
